item.title: Quintia Road
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: T2 Co., Ltd., Communication Group Plum
  • 発売日: 1991-07-19
  • スコア: 6.279999999999999/10 (5 人評価)
  • 日本語名: クィンティアロード
  • 英語名: Quintia Road

あらすじ

You play as Michael Ilgner, a German WWII pilot who gets his plane sucked into a strange vortex. He finds himself in the world of Quintia, a fantasy land filled with monsters, beautiful women, and a huge war. Being a soldier, Michael takes it upon himself to fight Quintia’s war and free the people from their monstrous oppressors. He never wanted to fight in WWII anyway, so he’s more than happy to fight for Quintia.
